---
title: "Privify"
subtitle: "A Computer Vision Pipeline for GDPR-Compliant Person and Face Anonymization in CCTV Video"
author:
  - name: "Marco Contin"
    affiliation: "Epicode Institute of Technology"
    email: "s00006824@epicode.edu.mt"
date: "June 2026"
abstract: |
  Privify is a Python computer vision pipeline that anonymizes people and
  faces in CCTV footage, supporting GDPR compliance for the small and medium
  enterprises that operate video surveillance. It combines a fine-tuned
  YOLOv8n face detector with a hybrid three-mode strategy (face, person_upper,
  person_full) that falls back to person detection for the street-level scenes
  where faces are too small to detect reliably. The central empirical finding
  is a measured domain shift: the in-distribution-optimized face detector
  reaches only 17.2% recall on the real CCTV target, against 80.4% for a
  generic person detector. Re-training on a small-face-biased subset of WIDER
  FACE recovers recall to 59.5% (a single-variable improvement of +42.4
  percentage points), but a residual gap remains that motivates the
  person-based modes. The system is a concrete illustration of the
  metric-versus-behavior gap in applied machine learning.
keywords: [computer vision, object detection, YOLOv8, GDPR, anonymization, domain shift, transfer learning, hybrid detection, person detection]
